summary: AEP Ohio declined to enter new or expanded data center service agreements in Central Ohio beginning March 2023, reported as lasting 28 months.

source.citation: Ohio Consumers' Counsel; Buckeye Institute policy brief, March 16 2026

notes: One source asserts it was imposed without prior Commission approval. That is a significant claim resting on a single advocacy publication. Pairs with utility-service entries in AZ and OR
